blocks.en: Understand what each element of method validation means in practice (accuracy, precision, specificity, etc.)

blocks.en: Understand the importance of the degassing procedure and the applicability of the different methods

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 量測品質控制的四層結構
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Four-Tier Structure of Measurement Quality Control

blocks.zh: USP 建立了一個嚴格的分層品質保證架構：
blocks.en: USP establishes a rigorous tiered quality assurance framework:

blocks.zh: 方法驗證（Method Validation）：一次性活動，證明方法能可靠測量目標量——參照 〈1225〉 / ICH Q2(R1)
blocks.en: Method validation: A one-time activity demonstrating that the method reliably measures the intended quantity; see <1225> / ICH Q2(R1).

blocks.zh: 儀器資格認證（IQ/OQ/PQ）：設備安裝後執行，確認儀器符合設計規格——參照 〈1058〉
blocks.en: Instrument qualification (IQ/OQ/PQ): Performed after the equipment is installed to confirm that the instrument meets its design specifications; see <1058>.

blocks.zh: 儀器標準化測試（IST）：定期執行（每季/每年），確認儀器持續符合製造商規格
blocks.en: Instrument standardization test (IST): Performed periodically (quarterly/annually) to confirm that the instrument continues to meet the manufacturer's specifications.

blocks.zh: 系統適用性測試（SST）：每次測試前/後執行，確認當次測試的系統狀態
blocks.en: System suitability test (SST): Performed before/after each test to confirm the state of the system for that test.

blocks.zh: 這四層是遞進關係：驗證建立信心 → 資格認證確認儀器 → IST 週期性確認 → SST 每次確認
blocks.en: The four tiers build on one another: validation builds confidence → qualification confirms the instrument → IST confirms periodically → SST confirms every time

blocks.zh: 公式重點 — 空白測試接受標準
blocks.en: Formula Highlights: Blank Test Acceptance Criterion

blocks.zh:
空白測試（Blank Test）標準：
  5 份 × 5 mL 過濾水 = 25 mL 總體積
  合計計數 ≤25 個 ≥10 µm 粒子
  ⟹ 等同 ≤1 粒子/mL

若超過此標準 → 表示：
  • 玻璃器皿未清潔乾淨
  • 環境污染過高
  • 試劑水不夠潔淨
  • 儀器本身有殘留
→ 必須找出原因後才能繼續測試
blocks.en:
Blank test criterion:
  5 portions × 5 mL of filtered water = 25 mL total volume
  Combined count ≤25 particles ≥10 µm
  ⟹ equivalent to ≤1 particle/mL

If this criterion is exceeded → it indicates:
  • Glassware is not cleaned adequately
  • Environmental contamination is too high
  • The reagent water is not clean enough
  • The instrument itself has residue
→ The cause must be found before testing can continue

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 校準微球的三大注意事項
blocks.en: Key Point: Three Precautions for Calibrator Spheres

blocks.zh: 不得使用注射用水（WFI）懸浮校準微球——使用粒子免含水（Particle-Free Water），因 WFI 中微量的潤滑劑/表面活性劑可能影響微球分散
blocks.en: Do not use water for injection (WFI) to suspend calibrator spheres. Use particle-free water, because trace lubricants/surfactants in WFI may affect the dispersion of the spheres.

blocks.zh: 聚集的微球必須丟棄——聚集的微球會造成尺寸和計數雙重偏差，且無法修正
blocks.en: Aggregated spheres must be discarded. Aggregated spheres cause errors in both size and count, and these cannot be corrected.

blocks.zh: NIST 可溯源性是必要條件——ISO 17034 認證的參考物質，才能保證儀器校準的計量溯源
blocks.en: NIST traceability is a requirement. Only reference materials certified to ISO 17034 can assure metrological traceability of the instrument calibration.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 巧合誤差（Coincidence Error）
blocks.en: Analogy: Coincidence Error

blocks.zh: 想像一個人工計數器：如果兩個球同時通過感測器，系統只會計數一個。這就是「巧合誤差」——在高濃度樣品中，真實粒子數被系統性地低估。
blocks.en: Imagine a manual counter: if two balls pass the sensor at the same time, the system counts only one. This is "coincidence error": in high-concentration samples, the true particle count is systematically underestimated.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼高濃度樣品必須先稀釋：確保粒子通過感測器的機率足夠低，同時通過兩個粒子的概率可以忽略。LO 在濃度超過約 10,000 粒子/mL 時誤差開始顯著。
blocks.en: This is why high-concentration samples must be diluted first: to make the probability of particles passing the sensor low enough that two passing at the same time is negligible. For LO, the error becomes significant at concentrations above about 10,000 particles/mL.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — CDMO 方法驗證的實際挑戰
blocks.en: Practical Application: Real-World Challenges of Method Validation at a CDMO

blocks.zh: 對於清澈低濃度小分子藥品，〈788〉 LO 方法幾乎不需額外開發，直接套用即可。但以下情況需要額外驗證工作：
blocks.en: For clear, low-concentration small-molecule drug products, the <788> LO method needs almost no additional development and can be applied directly. The following situations require additional validation work:

blocks.zh: 有色溶液（如維生素 B12、血紅蛋白製劑）→ 需評估顏色對 LO 遮光訊號的干擾
blocks.en: Colored solutions (such as vitamin B12 or hemoglobin preparations) → assess the interference of color with the LO obscuration signal

blocks.zh: 高黏度溶液（如透明質酸、高濃度蛋白）→ 需評估黏度對流速和粒子計數的影響
blocks.en: High-viscosity solutions (such as hyaluronic acid or high-concentration protein) → assess the effect of viscosity on flow rate and particle counting

blocks.zh: 含表面活性劑配方 → 可能在玻璃表面吸附，導致後續樣品的計數增加（carry-over）
blocks.en: Formulations containing surfactants → may adsorb onto glass surfaces, increasing counts in subsequent samples (carry-over)

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥品 → 回收率研究必須使用低折射率模型微球，而非標準聚苯乙烯微球
blocks.en: Protein drug products → recovery studies must use low-refractive-index model spheres rather than standard polystyrene spheres

blocks.zh: 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: LO 方法的「特異性低（low specificity）」意味著什麼？在什麼情況下這會造成嚴重的錯誤判斷？
blocks.en: What does the "low specificity" of the LO method mean? In what situations can it lead to serious misjudgment?

blocks.zh: 如果 IST 失敗，但 SST 通過，代表什麼？反之亦然？這兩個測試的失敗各代表什麼層級的問題？
blocks.en: If the IST fails but the SST passes, what does that mean? What about the reverse? What level of problem does a failure of each test represent?

blocks.zh: 為什麼蛋白聚集體的 LO 計數往往比 FI 計數低？這對放行決策有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why are LO counts of protein aggregates often lower than FI counts? What is the impact on release decisions?

blocks.zh: 12. Test Environment and Preparation | 測試環境與樣品準備
blocks.en: 12. Test Environment and Preparation

blocks.zh: 核心概念 — 樣品處理的黃金原則
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Golden Rules of Sample Handling

blocks.zh: 微粒分析最大的風險來自於「測試過程本身引入微粒」。樣品處理的每一步都可能是污染點：
blocks.en: The greatest risk in particle analysis is that "the testing process itself introduces particles". Every step of sample handling can be a point of contamination:

blocks.zh: 不潔的玻璃器皿 → 貢獻外源性微粒
blocks.en: Unclean glassware → contributes extrinsic particles

blocks.zh: 過度攪拌 → 氣泡偽計數或剪切性粒子形成
blocks.en: Excessive agitation → false counts from air bubbles, or shear-induced particle formation

blocks.zh: 開蓋取樣時的環境暴露 → 塵粒污染
blocks.en: Environmental exposure when the container is opened for sampling → dust contamination

blocks.zh: 移液操作的泡沫 → 假陽性計數
blocks.en: Foam from pipetting → false-positive counts

blocks.zh: 因此，測試環境（通常是 HEPA 保護區）和操作規程（SOP）的嚴格執行，是保證結果可信度的前提。
blocks.en: Therefore, a test environment (usually a HEPA-protected area) and strict adherence to operating procedures (SOPs) are prerequisites for reliable results.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 凍乾品復溶的挑戰
blocks.en: Analogy: The Challenge of Reconstituting Lyophilized Products

blocks.zh: 復溶凍乾藥品就像泡速溶咖啡：你需要充分溶解（不能有未溶粉末），但不能過度攪拌製造泡沫。對於蛋白質藥品，過度激烈的震盪還可能在水-空氣界面造成蛋白質展開和聚集——因此用輕柔的旋轉（swirling）而非用力搖晃（vigorous shaking）。
blocks.en: Reconstituting a lyophilized drug product is like making instant coffee: you need to dissolve it fully (no undissolved powder) but not stir so hard that you create foam. For protein drug products, overly vigorous shaking can also cause proteins to unfold and aggregate at the water-air interface, so use gentle swirling rather than vigorous shaking.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — Pharmacy Bulk Package 的計算邏輯
blocks.en: Practical Application: The Calculation Logic for a Pharmacy Bulk Package

blocks.zh: 藥局散裝包裝（100 mL 瓶，但最大單次劑量 10 mL）的微粒測試：
blocks.en: Particle testing of a pharmacy bulk package (a 100 mL bottle with a maximum single dose of 10 mL):

blocks.zh: 測試整瓶 LO，得到平均計數 C 粒子/mL
blocks.en: Test the whole bottle by LO to obtain an average count of C particles/mL

blocks.zh: 以最大劑量體積計算：報告值 = C × 10 mL
blocks.en: Calculate on the basis of the maximum dose volume: reported value = C × 10 mL

blocks.zh: 比對 SVI（≤100 mL）限量：≤6000（LO ≥10 µm）
blocks.en: Compare against the SVI (≤100 mL) limit: ≤6000 (LO ≥10 µm)

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯反映了風險評估的思維：患者單次暴露的粒子總量，才是真正的安全風險指標。
blocks.en: This logic reflects risk-assessment thinking: the total amount of particles to which the patient is exposed in a single dose is the real safety risk indicator.

blocks.zh: 公式概念 — 稀釋對測試結果的修正
blocks.en: Formula Concept: Correcting Test Results for Dilution

blocks.zh:
若樣品因黏度高需稀釋（稀釋因子 DF）：

報告計數 = 測量計數 × DF

注意：稀釋前必須驗證：
  1. 稀釋液不能溶解受測微粒
  2. 稀釋液本身的微粒背景足夠低
  3. 稀釋比例在方法線性範圍內
  4. 稀釋操作不會引入額外微粒
blocks.en:
If the sample must be diluted because of high viscosity (dilution factor DF):

Reported count = measured count × DF

Note: Before diluting, verify that:
  1. The diluent does not dissolve the particles being tested
  2. The particle background of the diluent itself is low enough
  3. The dilution ratio is within the linear range of the method
  4. The dilution operation does not introduce additional particles

blocks.zh: 一個高黏度玻尿酸眼科填充物（不是注射劑），你想評估其微粒負荷。列出你需要解決的前三個方法開發挑戰。
blocks.en: For a high-viscosity hyaluronic acid ophthalmic filler (not an injection), you want to evaluate its particle load. List the first three method development challenges you would need to resolve.

blocks.zh: 為什麼「樣品靜置脫氣」後需要再次輕柔混勻才能測試？不做這一步會造成什麼系統誤差？
blocks.en: Why must a sample be gently remixed before testing after "degassing by standing"? What systematic error results if this step is omitted?

blocks.zh: 空白樣品測試超出接受標準時，應採取哪些調查步驟？
blocks.en: When the blank test exceeds the acceptance criterion, what investigation steps should be taken?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 脫氣三方法的選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Key Point: The Selection Logic for the Three Degassing Methods

blocks.zh: 蛋白質藥品嚴禁使用超音波，因為超音波產生的熱能和剪切力會使蛋白質變性、形成聚集體，反而製造出你想偵測的問題。
blocks.en: Ultrasonication is strictly prohibited for protein drug products, because the heat and shear forces it generates can denature the protein and form aggregates, creating the very problem you are trying to detect.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 量測品質控制有四個層級：方法驗證 → 儀器資格認證 → IST（定期）→ SST（每次）；各有不同目的和頻率
blocks.en: Measurement quality control has four tiers: method validation → instrument qualification → IST (periodic) → SST (every test); each has a different purpose and frequency.

blocks.zh: 校準微球必須 NIST 可溯源、均徑偏差 ≤5%、懸浮於無粒子水（非 WFI）；出現聚集必須丟棄
blocks.en: Calibrator spheres must be NIST-traceable, with mean diameter deviation ≤5%, and suspended in particle-free water (not WFI); aggregated spheres must be discarded.

blocks.zh: LO 特異性低（計入氣泡和液滴），正式使用前必須以 MM 或 FI 確認計數性質
blocks.en: LO has low specificity (it counts air bubbles and droplets), so the nature of the counts must be confirmed by MM or FI before formal use.

blocks.zh: 脫氣方法需根據樣品性質選擇：蛋白質製劑嚴禁超音波；靜置後須再輕柔混勻以克服粒子沉降
blocks.en: The degassing method must be chosen according to the sample properties: ultrasonication is strictly prohibited for protein formulations; after standing, the sample must be gently remixed to overcome particle settling.

blocks.zh: 凍乾品復溶需輕柔操作，避免過激引發蛋白質聚集；雙室包裝需按標籤完整激活
blocks.en: Reconstitution of lyophilized products must be gentle to avoid protein aggregation caused by excessive agitation; dual-chamber packages must be fully activated according to the label.

blocks.zh: 稀釋、合併取樣等操作都需要前期可行性驗證，確認不引入或溶解受測微粒
blocks.en: Operations such as dilution and pooled sampling require prior feasibility validation to confirm that they do not introduce or dissolve the particles being tested.
